name: Pete Slipstream
features: fair skin, brown hair, blue eyes, British features, athletic build, early 30s appearance, slight facial definition, goatee
bio:
"It's just my face" he often says when somebody asks him why he's sad. A british young drafting specialist who has mastered the art of the tow. Pete's slipstream skills on long straights are simply unmatched.

Always wanted to beat every teammate that he had, and he often did. His rivalry with Mario Ravioli is one of the best of this era.
